findings.finding: Policy task is created before remaining original case time is required to be positive. Work between the prior screenshot await and inference admission can exhaust90s; negative/zero asyncio.wait timeout still schedules a policy task.
findings.required_correction: Refuse before create_task on nonpositive/nonfinite remaining, preserve original deadline, and prove no policy invocation in a pure test.

findings.finding: Installed Playwright1.60 TimeoutError inherits Playwright Error(Exception), not built-in TimeoutError. The native-timeout except tuple misses it, and generic Exception permits another case contrary to declared unknown-native session latch.
findings.required_correction: Route actual Playwright timeout class to permanent session abort, preserve outcome, and prove no following case/policy operation with a pure fake test.

findings.finding: Context close and subsequent video.path each receive a fresh10s timeout although docs describe one separate10s finalization allowance.
findings.required_correction: One original finalization deadline shared by both awaits, or explicitly review a changed bound before execution; retain no physical native-stop claim.

other_source_observations: Policy messages contain goal, unchanged PNG, viewport/remaining budget/sequence and prior action feedback; no receipt oracle, DOM identifiers, page source or reference boxes are provided.
Coordinate action batches are syntax-validated fully before dispatch. Native editable-focus query only validates type/select-all and is not fed to policy or used to choose target.
Ordinary fixture event handlers record supplied UI choices; the target equality oracle is held in Python and does not come from a model success claim.
Manual observations/commands join session/case/sequence/content hashes, with exclusive complete-file hardlink publication. Labels remain caller declarations, not verified Astra identity.

Verification pages were only rendered in author tests according to saved record; author reference development UI checks and done-only video bridge are test doubles, not model results. I did not repeat browser tests.
admission: Initial e043b7ec harness is not admitted while these findings remain. Preserve this finding history and bind a separate correction review to final bytes.
